cases.disease: CC2D2A-related ciliopathy with molar tooth sign (two affected siblings)
cases.mechanism_detail: Alu insertion (forward genomic strand) detected by MELT/SCRAMble reanalysis of exome data (Radboudumc cohort) and classified as disease-causing; inserted within coding sequence; functional effect not investigated.
